<thought>From the 13C NMR data, peaks in the 10‑40 ppm region correspond to methyl carbons. The spectrum shows peaks at 34.53 ppm (appearing twice, indicating two equivalent methyl carbons) and single peaks at 22.80, 21.35, and 19.20 ppm. Counting each methyl carbon gives 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 5 CH₃ groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
